title: Adaptive Multi-Mode Out-of-Distribution Detection for Trajectory Prediction in Autonomous Vehicles
abstract: arXiv:2509.13577v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Trustworthy trajectory prediction grounds autonomous vehicle (AV) safety, yet deployed models inevitably face out-of-distribution (OOD) scenes. Prior AV OOD detection targets perception, but planners act on predicted futures rather than raw scenes, so erroneous forecasts can slip past frame-level checks and corrupt control. We therefore tackle OOD detection at the trajectory-prediction level. Our analysis of real-world benchmarks reveals that prediction errors are often multi-modal, exhibiting distinct low- and high-error modes that evolve with open-world driving context. Observing this, we propose Mode-Aware CUSUM, which explicitly models multiple error modes while retaining the efficiency and general compatibility of classical CUSUM. translated_title: 自适应多模态自动驾驶车辆轨迹预测中的分布外检测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2509.13577v3 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：可信赖的轨迹预测是自动驾驶车辆（AV）安全的基础，然而部署的模型不可避免地会面临分布外（OOD）场景。先前的AV OOD检测主要针对感知层面，但规划器是基于预测的未来状态而非原始场景进行决策，因此错误的预测可能绕过帧级检查并影响控制。因此，我们着手解决轨迹预测层面的OOD检测问题。对真实世界基准的分析揭示，预测误差通常是多模态的，表现出不同的低误差和高误差模式，这些模式随开放世界驾驶环境而演变。基于此观察，我们提出了模式感知的CUSUM方法，该方法显式建模多种误差模式，同时保留经典CUSUM的效率和通用兼容性。通过动态识别活动误差模式并调整检测阈值，我们的方法能够在异构条件下实现稳健监控。在大规模轨迹基准上的实验表明，该方法具有有效性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种模式感知的CUSUM方法，通过显式建模轨迹预测中的多模态误差并动态调整检测阈值，实现了在自动驾驶车辆中更稳健的分布外检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Mode-Aware CUSUM method that explicitly models multi-modal prediction errors and dynamically adapts detection thresholds for more robust out-of-distribution detection in autonomous vehicle trajectory prediction.
